interface.name: enqueue
interface.description: Enqueue request; one operation per rising edge.

interface.name: dequeue
interface.description: Dequeue request; one operation per rising edge.

interface.name: reset
interface.description: TRUE resets the queue to empty; takes priority over enqueue and dequeue.

interface.name: elementCount
interface.description: Current number of valid elements, from zero through the queue capacity.

interface.name: status
interface.description: Invocation status: 16#0000 no error, 16#8001 dequeue from an empty queue, 16#8002 enqueue into a full queue.

interface.name: item
interface.description: Mutable scalar reference: read its value when enqueuing; write the removed front value on successful dequeue. Its concrete type must match the array element type.

interface.name: buffer
interface.description: Reference to a nonempty one-dimensional array with a single concrete element type, used as queue storage. Capacity is the actual array length.

scan_semantics: Inputs I[k] are sampled at invocation; outputs O[k] are observed after the call. Retained pre-state q[k] becomes q[k+1]. Each test resets the instance. A transition affects the same observed scan. dt_ms is elapsed time since the preceding invocation; the first invocation starts IEC timers at elapsed zero. CycleTime inputs, where supplied, are attributed to the current invocation rather than inferred from dt_ms.
safety_priority: Reset empties the logical queue before handling requests.
Rejected requests preserve queue and item.
assumptions: The official VARIANT interface is preserved. Native CODESYS compatibility and runtime type/array metadata access remain unverified; never silently replace it by a DINT-only interface.
Binding A: item DINT, buffer ARRAY[0..1] OF DINT. Binding B: item BOOL, buffer ARRAY[1..3] OF BOOL. Both must run to substantiate genericity.
Buffer is initialized and bound once per test; its association and contents are not externally overwritten between calls. item is caller-writable every scan.
Enqueue and dequeue are never requested together. Reset may coincide with either and wins.
Edge memories update during reset; a request held afterward is not another edge.
Reset need not clear buffer values. Unused storage arrangement is unconstrained.

formal_properties.name: Rejections
formal_properties.explanation: Full and empty failures preserve data.

formal_properties.name: FIFO order
formal_properties.explanation: Accepted edges update the ordered logical queue exactly once.

formal_properties.name: Count
formal_properties.explanation: Count remains within the actual caller capacity.

formal_properties.name: Held request
formal_properties.explanation: Held levels do not perform another operation.

atomic_propositions.pop_empty: NOT reset AND rising(dequeue) AND pre-count=0
atomic_propositions.push_full: NOT reset AND rising(enqueue) AND pre-count=capacity
atomic_propositions.same: logical queue equals pre-queue AND item equals sampled item
atomic_propositions.push: NOT reset AND rising(enqueue) AND pre-count<capacity
atomic_propositions.pushed: post-queue=pre-queue appended with sampled item AND count=pre-count+1 AND status=0
atomic_propositions.pop: NOT reset AND rising(dequeue) AND pre-count>0
atomic_propositions.popped: item=pre-front AND post-queue=pre-queue without front AND count=pre-count-1 AND status=0
atomic_propositions.idle: NOT reset AND no request rising edge
